{"consolidated_memory":"**Request timeout incidents in services/auth/session_store.py (authentication side)**

Three distinct occasions with the same problem (request timeout in the session store, 30 second deadline in gateway log) but different root causes and fixes:

**Occasion 1: [2026-05-03]**
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test (PR #2085 on branch fix/request-timeout-1)
- Repro: POST /login twice against a warm cache
- Test file: tests/auth/test_session_store.py
- Result: flaky test went from 10 failures per hundred runs to zero

**Occasion 2: [2026-07-16]**
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #7926 on branch fix/request-timeout-2)
- Repro: POST /login twice against a warm cache
- Test file: tests/auth/test_session_store.py
- Result: 68 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

**Occasion 3: [2026-08-18]**
- Trigger: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it (PR #8445 on branch fix/request-timeout-3)
- Repro: POST /login twice against a warm cache
- Test file: tests/auth/test_session_store.py (implied)
- Result: memory settled at 584 MB instead of climbing past 8 GB
- Note: same corner of services/auth/session_store.py as earlier work, context carried over

**Common elements:** All in Python stack, same component and test file, same reproduction technique, all triggered 30-second gateway deadline."}
